Scanned every open objectui PR's file list and the File surface lines of every `pm:dispatched` objectui claim just now; none touches `createBody.ts` or the designer save gate. objectui#12690 (the discard-draft confirm and toast) and objectui#12768 (`DirectoryPage.tsx`) are in `metadata-admin` but on other files. ## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12847 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-17T02:58Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `2074610`, against the card's Expected, the triage note (`6226269923`) and the claim (`6227469766`).

- **Shape:** the body says `Fixes #12810`; the second line is `Clause-②: no`. The changeset is `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
- **The change:**
  - `buildCreateModeBody` (`createBody.ts`) carries a spec create seed's structural defaults (a dataset's `count` measure, a page's `type`, …) but never its placeholder identity: `name`, `label`, and every top-level key whose value is the spec's placeholder object. Those come from the author or not at all.
  - The placeholder object is read from the seeds themselves (`getMetadataCreateSeed` over `listMetadataCreateSeedTypes`): the installed spec keeps `PLACEHOLDER_OBJECT` module-private, so there is no literal copy in objectui.
  - The shared create-mode save gate (`doSave` in `ResourceEditPage.tsx`; every designer uses it, A1 holds) refuses Save with no request when a placeholder key the author left blank is in the LIVE `/meta/types` schema's `required` list, and names the key. It is never stricter than the server that judges the body. A dataset with no base object is refused; no `PUT` carries the placeholder.
  - The message key went into the designer catalogue `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (en-US and zh-CN), which is where designer strings live, not the ten `packages/i18n` packs (A3 measured false; accepted).
- **Behaviour change, stated:** where the type requires a label (action, agent, dashboard, dataset, email_template, flow, page, skill, tool), Save with a blank Label is now refused at the client instead of saving the seed's "New X". This follows the ruling: the label is placeholder identity, and an item saved as "New Action" was the same class of defect. Where Label is optional, the item saves with no label. `page.object` is optional in the spec, so a page saves unbound rather than bound to the placeholder.
- **Pins:** `createBody.seedPlaceholders-12810` iterates every seed type (14 seed-carrying rows) and asserts each placeholder key is dropped or refused, so a future seed carrying a new placeholder turns it red. `ResourceEditPage.seedPlaceholder-12810` covers (a) a dataset with no object picked → refused, no `PUT`; (b) an object picked → the body carries it; plus controls. **Ablation:** deleting the line that drops placeholder keys turns 16 cases red (the (a) case, all 14 per-type rows, the dataset count case) while the controls stay green; the restore was proven by blob hash. 46 metadata-admin test files (275 tests) and 14 files rendering `MetadataResourceEditPage` (149 tests) are green; `app-shell` type-check exits 0.
- **Out-of-scope finding, filed:** filed objectui#12848: picking the base object on a new dataset clears the seed's `count` measure (`objectChangePatch` resets `measures: []` on the first pick). Confirmed on `main`.
- **Acceptance notes, not filed:** the object seed's `pluralLabel` ("New Objects") survives only when Label is blank, because the create form derives it from Label; it is not identity in the spec header.
- **Trailers:** the commit carries only the model-free pair.
- **CI at head:** 33 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 36 runs). Not governed (path audit); 461 changed lines.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.

## Landed · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-17T03:12Z

PR #12847 merged through the merge queue as `b921f90`, which is on `main`; `Fixes #12810` closed this card. Verified by content against the accepted head `2074610`:
- 5 of the PR's 6 files on `main` are blob-identical to that head.
- The sixth, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, moved under the PR on `main` (objectui#12844). The merge's own patch to it (`b921f90^1..b921f90`) is line-identical to the PR's.
- The merge commit's message names no model.

What landed:
- A create flow carries a spec seed's structural defaults but never its placeholder identity (`name`, `label`, the placeholder object binding). The placeholder object is read from the seeds, with no literal copy.
- The shared create-mode save gate refuses Save before any request when a placeholder the live type schema requires is still blank, and names it. A dataset with no base object can no longer be saved bound to the placeholder.
- An enumeration pin over every create seed type turns red if a future seed carries a new placeholder through.
- Behaviour change: Save with a blank Label is refused on the nine types whose label is required (stated in the ACCEPT).
- Released as `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.

Follow-up filed: objectui#12848 (picking the base object on a new dataset clears the seed's `count` measure).

This seat now removes `pm:dispatched`.
